_comment: Кая's user-facing strings, en — text the connector/delivery code sends the owner directly, or injects as a labeled note the model reads (voice_transcript_label, photo_note). See agents/kaya/strings.py.
voice_not_configured: Voice messages aren't set up yet (no SpeechKit key).
voice_too_long: That voice message is too long — I can handle up to a minute. Mind keeping it shorter?
voice_transcribe_failed: Couldn't transcribe that voice message, mind trying again?
voice_no_words: Couldn't make out any words in that voice message 🤔
photo_download_failed: Couldn't download that photo, mind trying again?
photo_note: [The owner sent a photo. File: {path} — open it (Read) and look before answering.]
unsupported_message: Right now I can only handle text, photos, and voice messages.
turn_crashed: Oops, something broke on my end for that message. Mind trying again?
